1.consolidated_definition: Hay una clase de piña especialmente apreciada a la cual se le llama piña de pan de azúcar, nombre que parece ya aludido en la Memoria de 1582: “Es buena fruta, suave, aunque colérica; es tan grande como un pan pequeño de azúcar, y a su hechura.” BHPR, 1914, I, 84.
1.en_consolidated_definition: There is a class of pineapple particularly prized to which it is referred as sugar loaf pineapple, a name that appears already alluded in the 1582 Memoir: "It is good fruit, soft, although choleric; it is as large as a small sugar loaf, and of its shape." BHPR, 1914, I, 84.
